title: FUSECO Forum 2024
html:
The 12th edition of FUSECO Forum conference is organized by Fraunhofer Fokus Institute in Berlin, during Nov 7-8, 2024 – registration and more details are available at:

  • https://www.fokus.fraunhofer.de/ngni/events/fuseco-forum_2024

The first day of the event is again filled with tutorials (spread across three tracks) and demos, with the second day scheduling a main conference track.

Event’s motto is: Forward to 6G! Understanding 5G Evolution Driven by Open Campus Networks, 6G RAN, Core Network Evolution, Non-terrestrial Networks and Data-/AI-based Networking

Daniel-Constantin Mierla, co-founder Kamailio, will participate with a workshop presentations about 5/6G RTC services with Open Source, chairing the afternoon sessions on the track 1: “Technologies and Enablers for Beyond 5G and 6G Networks: RAN, Core, NTN, and AI“.

Thanks for flying Kamailio!
